about_the_game:
Accompany Main on a journey through Corestate, a long fogotten kingdom, while he is trying to find his way back home.

Corestory is a 2D pixel-art action RPG where your choice matters. Explore a variety of different areas, upgrade your gear and overcome the challenges you may face.


Features (of the full game):

  • Sidescroller parts where combat is happening and top down parts for more "relaxed" gameplay at some locations

  • 14 different areas to explore. You may choose the path on which you progress yourself but also won't be left entirely clueless about where to go.

  • Different weapons and armor to unlock. Each weapon comes with its own unique charged attack, giving it a distinct playstyle.

  • Around 40 relics to find. Relics provide buffs, some specific, some generalistic, giving you the option to play how you want and to create your own builds.

  • Artifacts that unlock various powerful abilities and spells. These, in typical "Metroidvania fashion", might also come in handy during exploration.

  • Upgrade your gear with ores. Almost everything can be upgraded! Artifacts even unlock entirely new abilities that way.

  • Over 70 different enemies and 25 bosses to fight against

  • Meet a cast of memorable characters. Although not all of them may want to meet you...

  • And decide the stories course through your actions.

The demo only includes the content of the first 3 of the 14 areas. It is currently only available for Windows PCs, but it already comes with complete controller support.

content_descriptors.notes: May include stylized imagery of extreme forms of violence such as suicide.
